analogy: an assembly line with fixed stations
breaks: Each station here is a model call that can still return something unexpected.
A simulator answers the pilot's controls; a scripted mock replays only what was scripted, so it cannot surprise you the way a real model can.

analogy: a pharmacist who sees only the prescription slip in front of them
breaks: The model can be handed far more than a slip, and everything it is handed costs tokens.
The deltas are provisional; the message at the end is the one that counts.
